video_title: Why Two Incomes Made The Middle Class Poorer Than One
evidence: SponsorRadar identifies FSA Store sponsoring Austin Williams' August 14, 2026 English-language YouTube video 'Why Two Incomes Made The Middle Class Poorer Than One' and quotes the video's explicit FSA Store sponsor acknowledgement. SponsorRadar currently tracks at least 13 FSA Store sponsorships across 12 creators, including creators around 163K, 168K, 198K and 255K subscribers, making the brand realistic for small/mid-size channels. FSA Store is a physical health-and-wellness retail marketplace. FSA Store's official contact page has a dedicated Partnerships contact, and Health-E Commerce, the parent company of FSA Store, publicly publishes partnerships@fsastore.com for partnership inquiries. GitHub repository search immediately before staging returned no existing FSA Store record.
